product_metadata.title: SPIKG Hanging Jewelry Organizer Holder , Storage Bag for Earrings Necklace Bracelet Ring Accessory Display Holder Box (Beige -80 Pockets)
features: 【Material】Made of high quality non-woven polyester fabrics and clear PVC window. The hanging jewelry bags organizer for Earrings, Necklace, Bracelet, Ring, Hair Accessory.
【Dimension】 16.9 inch W X 31 inch H, a must-have piece that can hang on closet pole, door, or wall [Please Allow 0.3-1 inch error due to manual measurement].

【Double-Sided Design】Comes with 80 Pockets (40 pockets on each side). No need to put everything altogether and then scatter them throughout the room in the quest to find the little rings or earrings. You can put them in separate transparent pockets and select the one as they are visible.

【Easy To View And Pick】Transparent PVC window, easily view and protect items,endurable and good-looking (Metal Hanger Included). Differ from messy jewelry boxes, the case display jewelry well and opening pockets for convenient to pick something to wear with an outfit, takes up just as much space as a shirt hanging in the closet would.

【Convenient To Carry】This jewlery storage organizer for women, With a hanger, it is convenient to put it anywhere, it can rolls up for easy carry, perfect for travel use. Convenient to carry your jewelry like pendants, rings, chains, watches, bracelets, hair clips and even cosmetics or nail polish!
description: Specification: Color: Beige Material: Non-woven Fabric+ PVC Size: 16.9 inch W X 31 inch H Multi purpose: 80 pockets (front & back). Feature: Double-sided design with 40 pockets per side.
